W15.kind: synthetic fully sourced class fixture; not campaign acquisition

cardUnchanged.name: Arcane Bolt
cardUnchanged.effect: Arcane Bolt. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, universal, damage. Make a Wizard spell attack. On a hit deal S d6 + M force damage. Arcane Bolt is an always-prepared class matrix once acquired and uses the normal first-distinct-matrix and Refrain rules.

source.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

cardUnchanged.name: Minor Conjuration
cardUnchanged.frequency: At will while RP remains; one object at a time
cardUnchanged.effect: Minor Conjuration. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, conjuration. Create one nonmagical unattended object that fits inside a 1-foot cube, weighs no more than 10 pounds and is made of common nonvaluable material such as wood, cloth, clay, iron or glass. It cannot be food, poison, currency, a spell component with listed cost, ammunition with special properties or a functional complex mechanism. Creating another dismisses the first.

source.originalText: Minor Conjuration: Create a temporary, small inanimate object that lasts for 1 hour.

cardUnchanged.name: Arcane Recovery
cardUnchanged.duration: Instantaneous during a completed short rest
cardUnchanged.effect: Arcane Recovery. Tags: base, passive, resonance. Once between long rests when you complete a short rest, restore RP equal to half your Wizard class level rounded up, never above your normal maximum. This is RP recovery, not a second pool, and cannot trigger spell-cast, Refrain or Dissonance effects.

source.originalText: Arcane Recovery: Once per day during a short rest, recover RP equal to half your Wizard level (rounded up), up to your normal maximum.

cardUnchanged.name: Spell Scribing
cardUnchanged.effect: Spell Scribing. Tags: base, passive, spellbook. Copying a legal found Wizard spell into your spellbook requires 1 hour and 25 gp of inks and components per spell rank, treating rank 0 as rank 1 for this calculation, instead of the pilot baseline 2 hours and 50 gp. Level-up spells remain free.

source.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

cardUnchanged.name: Arcane Insight
cardUnchanged.effect: Arcane Insight. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. Gain proficiency in Arcana, or expertise if already proficient. When examining an active magical effect, spell residue, magic item or arcane construction, you may make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to determine its broad school, function or unusual matrix behavior. The Director sets the normal knowledge DC; failure supplies no invented fact.

source.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

cardUnchanged.name: Scholarly Mind
cardUnchanged.effect: Scholarly Mind. Tags: base, passive, knowledge. You have advantage on Intelligence checks whose primary purpose is recalling, researching or analyzing arcane theory, magical history, planar magical principles or constructed spell formulae. It does not grant advantage on spell attacks, Counterspell checks or general Investigation unrelated to arcane scholarship.

source.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

cardUnchanged.name: Arcane Sight
cardUnchanged.effect: Arcane Sight. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, divination, concentration. While active you perceive magical auras within 60 feet and automatically know each visible aura's school or broad magical category. As an Action on a later turn, examine one aura to learn whether it is concentrated, summoned, cursed, warded or linked to another visible magical effect. Total cover blocks sight.

source.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

cardUnchanged.name: Arcane Lock
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: One door, chest, portal or unattended object within touch
cardUnchanged.effect: Arcane Lock. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Magically seal the target. Opening it without your permission requires a Strength check or thieves'/arcane-tool check against your Wizard spell DC. Dispel Magic can end the lock. You can designate up to M creatures who can bypass it. This does not make the object physically indestructible.

source.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

cardUnchanged.name: Analyze Magic
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: One magical creature, object or effect within 30 feet
cardUnchanged.effect: Analyze Magic. Tags: base, active, wizard-spell, divination, knowledge. Make an Intelligence (Arcana) check against DC 10 + the effect's spell rank, treating a non-spell effect's Director-assigned tier as rank. On success learn its school or magical category, one active mechanical property and whether it is currently sustained, cursed or bound to another effect. Failure reveals only that magic is present.

source.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

cardUnchanged.name: Dispel Magic
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: One creature, object or magical effect within 60 feet
cardUnchanged.effect: Dispel Magic. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, abjuration. Choose one ongoing spell effect you can perceive. If its rank is 3 or lower, end it. If it is rank 4 or higher, make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + spell rank; success ends it. Permanent artifact properties and effects explicitly immune to dispelling are unaffected.

source.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

cardUnchanged.name: Spellbook Study
cardUnchanged.effect: Spellbook Study. Tags: base, active, matrix, ritual. Replace one currently prepared matrix with one legal spell recorded in your spellbook. The replacement must be within your Wizard rank limit. This is the normal midday substitution permission; it does not alter the spellbook, create another prepared-matrix position or reset first-cast/Refrain history for an underlying matrix family already cast this encounter.

source.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

cardUnchanged.name: Dimensional Pocket
cardUnchanged.effect: Dimensional Pocket. Tags: arch, active, wizard-spell, conjuration, ritual. Create an extradimensional storage space holding up to 100 pounds or 10 cubic feet of unattended nonliving material. Retrieving or placing an item while adjacent to the opening uses an object interaction. Living creatures cannot enter. When duration ends, remaining contents appear harmlessly in the nearest unoccupied space.

source.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

cardUnchanged.name: Matrix Efficiency
cardUnchanged.effect: Matrix Efficiency. Tags: base, passive, matrix. Your normal full daily Spell Matrix preparation time is reduced from 1 hour to 45 minutes. This does not reduce the separate 10-minute midday substitution ritual, spell scribing, rituals or spellbook reconstruction unless another feature explicitly says so.

source.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

cardUnchanged.name: Sigil Rewrite
cardUnchanged.effect: Sigil Rewrite. Tags: arch, passive-upgrade, matrix. Replace one prepared matrix with a different spell from your spellbook of exactly the same rank without performing the normal 10-minute ritual. The replacement receives no special Dissonance reset for a matrix family already used this encounter and must obey current Wizard rank eligibility.

source.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

cardUnchanged.name: Spell Preservation
cardUnchanged.effect: Spell Preservation. Tags: hero, spellbinder, passive, spellbook. Your primary spellbook cannot be destroyed, erased or rendered permanently unreadable by non-artifact mundane or magical means. It can still be stolen, hidden, transported, suppressed, sealed by an artifact-level effect or voluntarily abandoned. Copies and backup books do not automatically receive this protection.

source.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

cardUnchanged.name: Runic Snare
cardUnchanged.effect: Runic Snare. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, glyph, control. Place a visible-to-you glyph. The first hostile creature entering the square makes a Dexterity save. Failure deals S d6 force damage, causes Restrained until the end of its next turn and makes it drop one non-attuned held item of its choice. Success takes half damage with no restraint or drop. A Restrained target may repeat a Strength save at the end of its turn.

source.originalText: Runic Snare: Glyph trap explodes in a 2x2 root + disarm on trigger

cardUnchanged.name: Floating Preparation
cardUnchanged.effect: Floating Preparation. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. Increase your maximum prepared Spell Matrix count by 1. The extra matrix can come from any school and obeys all ordinary spellbook and rank restrictions. It is a prepared matrix for every rule, including protected strain, duplicate-family tracking and Matrix Mastery modifications.

source.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

cardUnchanged.name: Counterpulse
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Caster whose spell you successfully Counterspelled
cardUnchanged.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cardUnchanged.effect: Counterpulse. Tags: hero, spellbinder, counter, control. Immediately after your Counterspell succeeds, spend 1 RP. The countered caster is Silenced until the end of its next turn. This is part of the successful counter event rather than another spell cast and cannot trigger another Counterpulse.

source.originalText: Counterpulse: Countering a spell silences the caster for 1 round

cardUnchanged.name: Matrix Mastery
cardUnchanged.effect: Matrix Mastery. Tags: arch, passive, matrix. During preparation you may assign at most one common Matrix Mastery modification to each ordinary prepared spell: Quick Substitution, Component Enhancement, Matrix Linking or Stability Reinforcement, using the exact common definitions in the Wizard engine. Always-prepared class-card matrices cannot receive these modifications unless a card explicitly says otherwise.

source.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

cardUnchanged.name: Spell Absorption
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: One hostile spell that directly targets you
cardUnchanged.effect: Spell Absorption. Tags: hero, spellbinder, wizard-spell, abjuration. Trigger after you become the target of a hostile spell but before it resolves. Make an Intelligence check adding proficiency against DC 10 + twice the spell rank. On success that spell has no effect on you, though it resolves normally against other targets, and you gain temporary HP equal to spell rank + M. On failure it resolves normally and the use is spent.

source.originalText: Spell Absorption: Absorb a hostile spell, gaining temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

cardUnchanged.name: Improved Concentration
cardUnchanged.effect: Improved Concentration. Tags: arch, passive, concentration. You have advantage on Constitution saving throws made because damage threatens your concentration on a Wizard spell. This does not alter the DC, protect a Tether from rules that explicitly end both effects, or prevent Silence, incapacitation and other non-damage concentration failures.

source.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

W15.automaticFeatures: Exact Wizard engine/schedule bound in source; Divination specialization/School Mastery affect Divination only, not these Necromancy/Transmutation spells. Counterspell automatic2; rank1 cost3. Dispel selectedArch rank3 cost3, checkDC10+spellrank. No arbitrary Greater Dispel acquired.

repertoire.preparation: Actual fixture45minute preparation with MatrixEfficiency, physical book and focus, all four Life4 rank8 entries included under proposed static authority; remaining capacity empty; no unknown prepared spell activated.
repertoire.startingOtherSelections: Historical starting/earlier spellbook entries not activated here; no inference of arbitrary additional cast access.

C16.kind: synthetic fully sourced class fixture; not campaign acquisition

cardUnchanged.name: Divine Smite
cardUnchanged.effect: Divine Smite. Tags: smite, divine. Make a Cleric technique attack against one enemy. On a hit, deal S d8 + M radiant damage. This is one damage event. Invocation Path bonuses and features explicitly referring to Smite may modify it.

source.originalText: Divine Smite: Channel divine energy into a powerful strike against a single enemy, dealing damage based on your Wisdom and consuming 1 Conviction.

cardUnchanged.name: Healing Rite
cardUnchanged.effect: Healing Rite. Tags: rite, healing. One living ally regains S d8 + M HP. It cannot restore a dead creature or remove Wounds. Consecrated Ground and appropriate Invocation Path bonuses may modify this healing.

source.originalText: Healing Rite: A channeled ability that restores health to an ally, with increased effectiveness on consecrated ground.

cardUnchanged.name: Conviction Pool
cardUnchanged.effect: Conviction Pool. Tags: conviction, passive. Increase your Conviction maximum by 2. This changes only the maximum; it does not immediately restore spent Conviction when acquired during play. A long rest restores Conviction to the new maximum.

source.originalText: Conviction Pool: +2 max Conviction cap.

cardUnchanged.name: Fervent Ritualist
cardUnchanged.effect: Fervent Ritualist. Tags: rite, ritual, passive. When a Rite with a Ritual activation normally requires at least 10 minutes, reduce its required time by 1 minute for each full 10 minutes of its printed casting time. This never reduces a Ritual below 1 minute and does not alter Action, Bonus Action or Reaction Rites.

source.originalText: Fervent Ritualist: +10% faster channel speed on all Rites.

cardUnchanged.name: Sacred Chant
cardUnchanged.effect: Sacred Chant. Tags: chant, sustained, conviction. Pulse on start and once when maintained on each later regular turn with a Bonus Action. Under the base feature, the third pulse generates 1 Conviction. Only a real encounter can generate Conviction this way. Maintenance itself does not otherwise heal, damage or grant Conviction.

source.originalText: Sacred Chant: A sustained prayer that generates 1 Conviction every 3 turns while maintained.

cardUnchanged.name: Consecrate
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: 15-foot-radius fixed zone centered at a point within 30 feet
cardUnchanged.effect: Consecrate. Tags: rite, zone. Create sanctified terrain. Your Consecrated Ground feature recognizes this zone. Undead creatures in the zone have -1 on attack rolls. A creature leaving the zone loses that penalty immediately. Only one Consecrate zone created by you may exist at a time; creating another ends the first.

source.originalText: Consecrate: Sanctify the ground in a 15-foot radius, creating consecrated terrain that enhances your healing abilities and weakens undead enemies.

cardUnchanged.name: Divine Invocation
cardUnchanged.effect: Divine Invocation. Tags: invocation, bishop. Use only your selected Invocation Path. Radiance: up to 3 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP; one may end Frightened or Poisoned. Judgment: one enemy within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save, taking (S+1)d8 radiant on failure or half on success; failure also applies Judged for 2 rounds. Renewal: up to 2 allies within 30 feet each regain S d8+M HP and 5 Stamina. Flame: creatures in a 15-foot cone make Dexterity saves, taking (S+1)d8 fire on failure or half on success; failed targets also take 1d6 fire at the start of their next turn. Veil: up to 3 allies within 30 feet can see invisible/ethereal creatures within 30 feet and gain advantage on saves against illusions for 3 rounds. Echoes: choose one eligible Smite or Rite you resolved this turn or previous regular turn and one original target within 30 feet; repeat 50% of its immediate unmodified rolled damage or healing dice, rounded down once, minimum 1 for a positive source, with no copied conditions, resources or triggers.

source.originalText: Divine Invocation: Channel a powerful prayer based on your chosen Invocation Path, with effects ranging from mass healing to divine fire or protective barriers.

cardUnchanged.name: Sacrament
cardUnchanged.cost: 3 Conviction + 4 RP to start; 1 RP maintenance
cardUnchanged.effect: Sacrament. Tags: sacrament, rite, sustained, zone. Pulse on start and on each paid Bonus Action maintenance. At each pulse, up to three allies in the zone gain +1 on saving throws until the start of your next regular turn or effect end, whichever is first. Up to three Undead or Fiends in the zone make Wisdom saves, taking S d6 radiant damage on failure or half on success. Maximum 3 pulses.

source.originalText: Sacrament: Perform a sacred ceremony that consumes Conviction to create a powerful, sustained effect in an area.

cardUnchanged.name: Divine Insight
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Self; subject matter concerning a religious matter, sacred location or divine presence
cardUnchanged.effect: Divine Insight. Tags: ritual, information. Ask the Director one specific factual question about a religious practice, sacred location, divine presence or recognized supernatural sign available to your tradition. Receive one truthful fact, symbolic clue or 'unknown' if the information is genuinely unavailable. This never forces certainty about future events or another character's private beliefs.

source.originalText: Divine Insight: Commune briefly with your deity to gain insight about a religious matter, sacred location, or divine presence.

cardUnchanged.name: Anointed Guardian
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: First ally within 30 feet to fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less
cardUnchanged.effect: Anointed Guardian. Tags: protection, bishop. The first qualifying ally in an encounter gains a ward for 2 rounds. The first time during each round that ally takes damage, reduce that damage by PB + M, minimum 0. The ward does not prevent conditions attached to an attack unless the damage reduction itself invalidates them under another rule.

source.originalText: Anointed Guardian: First time an ally drops below 20% HP per combat, grant them a 30% damage reduction shield for 2 rounds.

cardUnchanged.name: Banish Unholy
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Up to three Undead or Fiends within 30 feet
cardUnchanged.duration: Instantaneous; banishment rider lasts until end of target's next turn
cardUnchanged.effect: Banish Unholy. Tags: divine, control. Each target makes a Wisdom save. Failure deals (S+1)d8 radiant damage and pushes it up to 15 feet directly away from you; success takes half damage and no push. A target failing by 10 or more is also banished until the end of its next turn, then returns to the nearest legal space.

source.originalText: Banish Unholy: Channel divine energy to damage and potentially banish undead, demons, or other unholy entities.

cardUnchanged.name: Sanctified Reprisal
cardUnchanged.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cardUnchanged.effect: Sanctified Reprisal. Tags: healing, smite, bishop. After one of your Cleric features restores HP to a living creature, empower your next Divine Smite before the end of your next regular turn. On a hit it deals S d4 additional radiant damage. If the target is Undead, it must also make a Constitution save; failure Stuns it until the end of its next turn.

source.originalText: Sanctified Reprisal: Whenever you heal, next Smite deals 20% more damage and stuns Undead.

cardUnchanged.name: Miraculous Channel
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Your next ally-targeting Rite this turn
cardUnchanged.effect: Miraculous Channel. Tags: rite, channel, bishop. Your next Rite this turn that normally affects one or more willing allies may affect up to six legal willing allies within the Rite's normal range instead. Roll shared healing or numeric effects once and apply normally. It does not multiply hostile targets, corpse targets or resource generation.

source.originalText: Miraculous Channel: Sacrificing 3 Conviction causes your next Rite to affect the full party.

cardUnchanged.name: Commune
cardUnchanged.effect: Commune. Tags: ritual, information, bishop. Ask up to three questions concerning divine doctrine, sacred duties, supernatural threats or a course of action. For each, the Director answers truthfully with yes, no, unclear or a brief symbolic response based on what the contacted divine source could know. Commune cannot compel a deity, reveal another player's private belief, or guarantee a future choice.

source.originalText: Commune:  Enter a deep meditative state to receive guidance directly from your deity, gaining insight on important matters or divine intervention.

cardUnchanged.name: Sanguine Rite
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Self and one ally within 30 feet
cardUnchanged.frequency: At most once on each of your turns
cardUnchanged.effect: Sanguine Rite. Tags: cultist, rite, healing. When one of your Rites deals damage to at least one enemy, choose one living ally within 30 feet. That ally regains HP equal to half the actual damage dealt to one chosen damaged enemy, rounded down, maximum S+M HP. This healing cannot trigger Sanguine Rite again.

source.originalText: Sanguine Rite:  Rites damage enemies and heal allies for a portion of the same amount.

cardUnchanged.name: Blood Sacrifice
cardUnchanged.cost: Lose S+M actual HP from yourself or one willing ally within 5 ft
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: Self or one willing ally within 5 feet
cardUnchanged.duration: Empowerment lasts until end of your next regular turn
cardUnchanged.effect: Blood Sacrifice. Tags: cultist, sacrifice, conviction. The chosen creature loses S+M actual HP; this loss cannot be reduced, redirected or transferred and cannot reduce it below 1 HP. The donor must have strictly more current HP than this cost before activation; otherwise it is illegal. You gain 1 Conviction. Your next damaging or healing Rite or Invocation before the end of your next regular turn adds 1d8 to one rolled damage or healing component. A creature must be willing unless the target is you.

source.originalText: Blood Sacrifice: Sacrifice a portion of your health or an ally's to generate Conviction and empower your next divine ability.

cardUnchanged.name: Consecrated Ground
cardUnchanged.effect: Consecrated Ground. Tags: rite, healing, passive. Whenever one of your healing Rites restores HP to a living creature standing in terrain created by your Consecrate feature, that creature regains S additional HP. Apply this once per creature per Rite pulse; it is flat healing and is not itself another healing trigger.

source.originalText: Consecrated Ground: Healing allies on terrain you sanctify (via Rite) heals for +10%.

cardUnchanged.name: Dark Conviction
cardUnchanged.frequency: At most once on each of your turns
cardUnchanged.effect: Dark Conviction. Tags: cultist, conviction. During a real encounter, when a hostile non-summoned creature that meaningfully threatened the party dies after taking damage from one of your Cleric features since the start of your current turn, gain 1 Conviction. Friendly creatures, summoned creatures, trivial staged creatures and repeated corpse destruction never qualify.

source.originalText: Dark Conviction: Killing an enemy grants 1 Conviction instantly.

cardUnchanged.name: Judging Light
cardUnchanged.effect: Judging Light. Tags: smite, passive. When your Divine Smite damages a creature currently affected by a Cursed or Weakened condition, add S d4 radiant damage to that Smite. Roll these dice once as part of the Smite; they do not create a second hit or trigger.

source.originalText: Judging Light: Smite deals +20% bonus damage to enemies afflicted by Cursed or Weakened effects.

cardUnchanged.name: Zealot's Touch
cardUnchanged.effect: Zealot's Touch. Tags: cultist, rite, necrotic. When starting a Rite whose printed pulse would restore HP over multiple turns, you may designate a hostile creature instead of a healing recipient. At each applicable pulse that enemy makes a Wisdom save. On failure it takes necrotic damage equal to the Rite's rolled healing dice; on success it takes half. Flat healing bonuses are not converted. The enemy receives no healing.

source.originalText: Zealot's Touch: Healing over time effects become life drain if cast on enemies.

cardUnchanged.name: Sermon of Purpose
cardUnchanged.effect: Sermon of Purpose. Tags: chant, conviction, bishop. Sacred Chant generates its 1 Conviction on its second pulse instead of its third. A normal three-pulse Sacred Chant still generates only 1 Conviction total unless another feature explicitly extends it or grants an additional generation event.

source.originalText: Sermon of Purpose: Chants now generate 1 Conviction every 2 turns.

cardUnchanged.name: Ritual of Undeath
cardUnchanged.rangeAndTarget: One eligible corpse within 30 feet or one living ally within 30 feet
cardUnchanged.effect: Ritual of Undeath. Tags: cultist, undead, rite. Choose one mode. Corpse Servant: one humanoid corpse dead no more than 1 minute rises for 3 rounds as a temporary thrall with AC 13, 10 HP, Speed 30 feet and one attack only when you spend your shared companion Bonus Action command using your Cleric technique attack bonus; on hit it deals S d6 necrotic. The thrall disappears at 0 HP or when duration ends and grants no XP, loot, new corpse, Conviction or resurrection target. Death Ward: one living ally is marked for 1 minute; the first time it would die during that duration, it instead remains at 1 HP and counts as both humanoid and undead until the end of its next turn. Neither mode removes Wounds. The Conviction expenditure can vent Dissonance once.

source.originalText: Ritual of Undeath: Perform a forbidden ritual that can temporarily raise fallen enemies as servants or prevent allies from dying by transforming them into undead-like entities.

C16.activeCapability: Selected card57 Ritual of Undeath, level16 Action,30ft living ally,3Conviction+6RP,1/LR. Its Ward mode is not ordinary Death Ward, no spell-rank cast strain; spending3Conviction can vent1Dissonance once on actual regular turn. No ordinary spell is cast by this fixture.
